task.title: Sweep departed board cards before reconciling columns
task.description:
Follow-up to PR #32 (WB-01KZC3PGA0QCXKDQ936VPM67D5). In internal/webui/assets/index.html render() (roughly lines 2036-2054) the loop `grouped.forEach(... reconcile ...)` runs over all six columns first, and only afterwards does `survivors.forEach((node, taskID) => ... node.remove())` drop the nodes no column claimed.

Consequence: while a column is being reconciled, a card that has left it (status change, or deletion) is still attached in that list and therefore still present in reconcile's `placed` array. Every survivor that used to sit below it fails the `placed[index] === node` check and takes an unnecessary insertBefore. Measured in the branch's own test harness: with the three-card Ready column from reconcileBoardTasks(), changing Alpha's status to done produces 2 insertBefore calls on `ready` — Bravo and Charlie are both re-inserted even though neither moved relative to the model.

Real-board impact: another client moves the top card out of a 69-card Ready column and all 68 remaining cards are detached and re-inserted. A browser blurs a node when it is re-inserted, so a keyboard user parked on card 40 gets a focusout/focusin pair for a change that did not concern their card; the restoreCardFocus backstop returns focus to the article, not to the copy button if that is what was focused.

Suggested fix (cheap): build the set of desired task IDs from `grouped` before the reconcile loop and remove unclaimed survivor nodes first, so departed nodes are already detached by the time `placed` is computed. Keep the existing exemption for activeDrag's node. Worth a test asserting zero insertBefore calls on the neighbours of a card that leaves a column.

Deferred from PR #32 as a minor finding: it costs extra DOM churn in a narrow case but does not break any acceptance criterion, and the PR is green on both CI jobs.
